proposal.summary: SSRF vulnerability in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3. An administrator can bypass database restrictions on the query settings page and connect to an unintended database.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) prior to version 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: Server-side request forgery vulnerability exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3. A user who can access the affected product with an administrative privilege may bypass the database restriction set on the query setting page, and connect to a user unintended database.
